title: Bug 649580: [Subcontracting] Transfer Shipment report is missing subcontractor and manufacturing references
summary: The Subcontracting Transfer Shipment report now displays subcontractor and manufacturing references through a new layout extension in the Subcontracting app, while the legacy IT report retains basic transfer shipment functionality without subcontracting dependencies.
key_points: Report 12154 simplified to show ordinary transfer shipments without subcontracting fields
New report extension for standard report 5704 with subcontractor, purchase order, and production order details
Legacy report dataset columns preserved as blank compatibility values for existing consumers
Subcontracting reporting logic moved into the app to respect app boundaries
New and refactored tests added for both standard and subcontracting transfer shipment scenarios
quote: Report 12154 remains available in the IT BaseApp for ordinary posted transfer shipments without depending on Subcontracting fields.
